lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr₂Mg₁₄Si₂ (reduced formula ZrMg₇Si) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-6m2 (No. 187), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that Mg, Si, and Zr centers each adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments involve varying Mg, Si, and Zr neighbor combinations, while Si and Zr are surrounded primarily by Mg. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, and Mg–Zr polyhedra with corner and edge sharing.
